column1: # Provisional game profile (generated by scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py from the survey with dm/games/profile_guess.py, not checked by hand)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory (Age of Calamity: 66.6 MB → 72 MB)
# The colour grading LUT (32x32x32 RGBA16F, 3D, flags IMAGE) is filled by the CPU in a CPU_UNCACHED | GPU_CACHED | COMPRESSIBLE pool (flags 0xa2), memory the movie's
# 1280x720 target used before, with no flush. Without these keys its image held zeros and the exposure pass multiplied every 3D scene to black (combat, dialogue backgrounds)
# KTGL reads its light and decal lists (texture slots 16-21) and other tables (0-3, 29-31) from texture buffers with 1D integer fetches the answer table has no type for.
# As 2D rows they read the dummy view: 15 more shaders logged it in one fight, and the stage lights flashed on every hit. Translated as texture buffers instead
# (dm/android/tools/shader_vk.py); a slot answered in shader_facts_manual.tsv keeps its answer. The skinning shaders' bone matrices (slots 0-3) come in a texture buffer
# for some characters and in a 2D texture for others: answered as buffers, the 2D kind read zeros and the body vanished in a dialogue scene (only the head drew).
# The same key makes the host read such a 2D texture as its row 0 (dm/android/gfx_vk_tex.c vk_tex_row_view)
# Handheld, not the default docked (console): docked the heaviest battle drew 300-418 passes and 1,400-1,870 draws a frame, GPU p50 28-33 ms at the 680 MHz top
# (24-26 fps). Handheld (tested with DM_OPMODE=0) in the same battle: 183-278 passes, 600-1,060 draws, GPU p50 20-24 ms, frame time p50 33.5 ms. Targets stay 1600x900
